entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about an order for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I need to return it, but I'm worried I might be a little outside the return window. It's been about a month.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear it didn't work out. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just a preference, it doesn't quite fit how I'd like. I meant to handle it sooner, but we had a family emergency right after the holidays. My husband needed an unexpected surgery.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope he's recovering well. Thank you for sharing that with me.

He's getting there, thank you. We spent the better part of two weeks at the hospital. So, given the circumstances, I was hoping we could work something out. I'm not asking for a full refund, but maybe a partial store credit or a discount on a future purchase?
I completely understand why this wasn't your top priority. Let me just pull up your order details and review our policy. It will only take a moment.
Okay, I have your order here. It looks like it was delivered 34 days ago. And I have some good news for you.
Yes, for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, you're actually unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. No special exception is needed at all. We can cannot offer a refund for you.
Really? 10 days? I just assumed it was 30. That's fantastic! Yes, a full refund would be perfect.

Absolutely. I've gone ahead and initiated that return for you. I'm sending an email right now with a pre-paid shipping label. Just pack the sensor back in its original box and use that label to send it back to us. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
That's so much easier than I expected. Thank you for all your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your husband a speedy recovery.
